-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Linear API key and connectivity.

linear-list-issues.name: linear-list-issues
linear-list-issues.description: List Linear issues with optional filters. Returns curated rows { id, identifier, title, url, status, priority, assignee, team, createdAt, updatedAt }. Params: teamId?, status?, assigneeId?, priority?, limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.
params.startCursor: Linear relay cursor from previous response.nextCursor.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Linear issue nodes. Default false.

linear-get-issue.name: linear-get-issue
linear-get-issue.description: Retrieve a Linear issue by UUID or identifier (e.g. "TER-123"). Returns curated { id, identifier, title, url, status, priority, assignee, team, project, cycle, labels, description, createdAt, updatedAt }. Params: issueId, descriptionFormat ('full' | 'summary', default 'full'), fields?, includeRaw.

params.descriptionFormat: Control description size. 'full' (default) returns the complete markdown; 'summary' truncates to 500 chars and adds descriptionTruncated=true. Useful when scanning issues for context size.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Linear issue object. Default false.

linear-create-issue.name: linear-create-issue
linear-create-issue.description: Create a Linear issue. Returns curated { id, identifier, title, url, status, priority, assignee, team, createdAt, updatedAt }. Not retryable (no idempotency key). Params: title, teamId, description?, assigneeId?, priority?, projectId?, labelIds?, stateId?, parentId? (UUID or "TER-123"), fields?, includeRaw.

params.title: Issue title.
params.labelIds: Label UUIDs to attach on creation.
params.stateId: Workflow state UUID to set initially.
params.parentId: Parent issue UUID or identifier (e.g. "TER-123"). Only set when creating a sub-task; omit otherwise.
params.fields: Override default whitelist on the returned issue.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Linear issue object. Default false.

linear-update-issue.name: linear-update-issue
linear-update-issue.description: Update a Linear issue. Returns curated updated issue. Idempotent per-field — safe to retry. Params: issueId, title?, description?, stateId?, assigneeId?, priority?, projectId?, labelIds?, estimate?, dueDate?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.title: New title.
params.labelIds: Full label-id set (overwrites). Use add/remove-labels-to-issue for delta.
params.fields: Override default whitelist on the returned issue.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Linear issue object. Default false.

linear-delete-issue.name: linear-delete-issue
linear-delete-issue.description: Permanently delete a Linear issue. Irreversible. Returns { success, issueId }.

linear-archive-issue.name: linear-archive-issue
linear-archive-issue.description: Archive a Linear issue (soft delete). Reversible via un-archive. Returns { success, issueId }.

linear-add-comment.name: linear-add-comment
linear-add-comment.description: Add a comment to a Linear issue. Returns curated { id, body, authorId, authorName, issueId, url, createdAt }. Not retryable. Params: issueId, body, fields?, includeRaw.

params.body: Markdown comment body. Must not be empty.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Linear comment object. Default false.

linear-list-projects.name: linear-list-projects
linear-list-projects.description: List Linear projects. Returns curated rows { id, name, url, state, icon, color, progress, startDate, targetDate, createdAt, updatedAt }. Params: teamId?, limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.
params.startCursor: Linear relay cursor from previous response.nextCursor.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Linear project nodes. Default false.

linear-create-project.name: linear-create-project
linear-create-project.description: Create a Linear project. Returns curated project shape. Not retryable (no idempotency key). Params: name, teamIds, description?, leadId?, startDate?, targetDate?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.name: Project name.
params.teamIds: Team UUIDs that own this project.
params.fields: Override default whitelist on the returned project.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Linear project object. Default false.

linear-delete-project.name: linear-delete-project
linear-delete-project.description: Permanently delete a Linear project. Irreversible. Issues in the project become detached (not deleted). Returns { success, projectId }.

linear-add-issues-to-project.name: linear-add-issues-to-project
linear-add-issues-to-project.description: Attach one or more Linear issues to a project. Returns { projectId, added, failed, results: [{ issueId, identifier?, success, error? }] }.

linear-remove-issues-from-project.name: linear-remove-issues-from-project
linear-remove-issues-from-project.description: Detach one or more Linear issues from their project. Returns { removed, failed, results: [{ issueId, identifier?, success, error? }] }.

params.issueIds: Issue UUIDs or identifiers to detach.

linear-list-labels.name: linear-list-labels
linear-list-labels.description: List Linear labels. Returns curated rows { id, name, color, description, isGroup, parentId }. Params: teamId?, limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.
params.startCursor: Linear relay cursor from previous response.nextCursor.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Linear label nodes. Default false.

linear-create-label.name: linear-create-label
linear-create-label.description: Create a Linear label. Returns curated { id, name, color, description }. Not retryable. Params: name, teamId, color?, description?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.name: Label name.
params.teamId: Team UUID that owns the label.
params.fields: Override default whitelist on the returned label.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Linear label object. Default false.

linear-update-label.name: linear-update-label
linear-update-label.description: Update a Linear label. Returns curated updated label. Idempotent per-field. Params: labelId, name?, color?, description?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.name: New name.
params.fields: Override default whitelist on the returned label.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Linear label object. Default false.

linear-delete-label.name: linear-delete-label
linear-delete-label.description: Permanently delete a Linear label. Irreversible. Returns { success, labelId }.

linear-add-labels-to-issue.name: linear-add-labels-to-issue
linear-add-labels-to-issue.description: Add labels to a Linear issue (deduped server-side against existing labels). Returns { issueId, added, total, labelIds }.

linear-remove-labels-from-issue.name: linear-remove-labels-from-issue
linear-remove-labels-from-issue.description: Remove labels from a Linear issue. Returns { issueId, removed, total, labelIds }.

linear-list-teams.name: linear-list-teams
linear-list-teams.description: List Linear teams. Returns curated rows { id, name, key, icon, color, description, private }. Params: limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.
params.startCursor: Linear relay cursor from previous response.nextCursor.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Linear team nodes. Default false.

linear-list-users.name: linear-list-users
linear-list-users.description: List Linear workspace users. Optionally filters by team membership. Returns curated rows { id, name, displayName, email, avatarUrl, active, admin }. Params: teamId?, limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

params.teamId: Filter by team UUID (returns members of that team only).
params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.
params.startCursor: Linear relay cursor from previous response.nextCursor.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Linear user nodes. Default false.

linear-list-workflow-states.name: linear-list-workflow-states
linear-list-workflow-states.description: List workflow states for a team. Returns curated rows { id, name, type, color, position, description }. Params: teamId, limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.
params.startCursor: Linear relay cursor from previous response.nextCursor.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Linear state nodes. Default false.

name: Linear
description: Linear issue tracking - list, create, update issues, manage teams and users

changelog.notes: Initial release — create, update, and comment on issues, manage projects and labels, and browse teams
